name: Easy Three
description: Clear the Easy Level in either Planet Quest, Survival Four, or Co-op With COM.

name: Normal Four
description: Clear the Normal Level in either Planet Quest, Survival Four, or Co-op With COM.

name: Hard Five
description: Clear the Hard Level in either Planet Quest, Survival Four, or Co-op With COM.

name: Extreme All
description: Clear the Extreme Level in either Planet Quest, Survival Four, or Co-op With COM.

name: Five Wins
description: Get 5 wins in one of the online modes. Must be ranked matches.

name: Triple Five Wins
description: Get 5 wins in every online mode. Must be ranked matches.

name: Music Tank
description: Use the Beat-O-Matic analyzer and create 5 syncronized data files of your favorite songs.

name: Chain Wizard
description: Achieve more than 10 chains in the Single Player mode or 2 Player Co-op mode.

name: Hyper Sniper
description: Do 10 Hyper Modes in all 10 stages of the Single Player mode or 2 Player Co-op mode.

name: Twin Sync
description: In Co-op With COM mode, perform 5 Super Synchronized Bonuses within the 10 stages.

name: Beat Master
description: In a Single Player game, achieve 8 continuous Beat Drops on the max Beat Bonus Level.

name: Longest Snake
description: In a Single Player game, connect over 50 Pieces and then eliminate them.
